names.name: The Melancholy Thistle
names.note: Hoary stalk, weakly prickly leaves, single head.

cul:299-the-melancholy-thistle.ref: Culpeper, Complete Herbal: The Melancholy Thistle
cul:299-the-melancholy-thistle.text: It is under Capricorn, and therefore under both Saturn and Mars, one rids melancholy by sympathy, the other by antipathy. Their virtues are but few, but those not to be despised; for the decoction of the thistle in wine being drank, expels superfluous melancholy out of the body, and makes a man as merry as a cricket; superfluous melancholy causes care, fear, sadness, despair, envy, and many evils more besides; but religion teaches to wait upon God’s providence, and cast our care upon him who cares for us. What a fine thing were it if men and women could live so? And yet seven years’ care and fear makes a man never the wiser, nor a farthing richer. Dioscorides saith, the root borne about one doth the like, and removes all diseases of melancholy. Modern writers laugh at him; _Let them laugh that win_: my opinion is, that it is the best remedy against all melancholy diseases that grows; they that please may use it.
